name: test-layer-lab
description: An evidence-driven laboratory for comparing test-layer cost, defect detection, and confidence.

scripts.test: npm run check && npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:unit:allure: node --test --test-reporter spec --test-reporter-destination stdout --test-reporter allure-node-test/reporter --test-reporter-destination stdout tests/unit/*.test.js
scripts.test:integration:allure: node --test --test-reporter spec --test-reporter-destination stdout --test-reporter allure-node-test/reporter --test-reporter-destination stdout tests/integration/*.test.js
scripts.test:e2e:allure: node --test --test-reporter spec --test-reporter-destination stdout --test-reporter allure-node-test/reporter --test-reporter-destination stdout tests/e2e/*.test.js
scripts.test:allure: npm run test:unit:allure && npm run test:integration:allure && npm run test:e2e:allure && npm run test:browser:allure
scripts.mutation:evidence: npm run mutation:automated && npm run audit:manual
